title: Keep chat resilient when Skills fail to load
goal: Prevent malformed or unavailable Skills from freezing chat: isolate malformed manifests, report the affected Skill when recoverable, and continue through normal Agent chat fallback without bypassing policy or verification.
context: FileSkillStore.loadAll currently throws on the first malformed markdown file. Because both discovery and load use this shared operation, one broken custom Skill can poison the whole store and make unrelated chat Skill requests fail with malformedSkill. Isolate malformed siblings while retaining duplicate-ID rejection and targeted parse errors. Follow-up requirement: if a requested Skill cannot be loaded or resolved, the chat should explicitly disclose the Skill failure and continue with the normal model/runtime path when safe, instead of stopping the entire conversation.
forbidden_changes: Do not make malformed Skills executable or infer missing manifest fields.
Do not silently resolve duplicate valid Skill IDs.
Do not weaken Agent scope, policy/approval, schema validation, path protections, cancellation, or result verification.
Do not claim physical-device acceptance from CI.
acceptance_criteria: Discovery excludes malformed Skill.md files but still returns healthy manifests.
Loading a healthy Skill succeeds when an unrelated malformed Skill file exists.
Loading a specifically requested malformed Skill returns a parse error and never executes it.
Duplicate valid Skill IDs remain a store-level error.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
Recoverable Skill-load/manifest errors in chat are identified to the user and continue through normal chat fallback.
Policy denial, required approval, cancellation, and execution verification failures never trigger fallback that could bypass the security boundary.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: If malformed files can still poison healthy Skill loading, narrow the parser error isolation without relaxing validation. If duplicate IDs stop failing closed, revert the change and repair the conflict handling.
